text: It doesn't make sense to display multiple writes to the same chat. Aggregate to the most recent write
Tests and type check pass. Now I'll update the timeline card.

The timeline now shows one "Wrote in …" row per chat instead of one per message. That row is your most recent write, placed at the time you sent it.

- **New writes:** when you send a message, the row for that chat's earlier message is replaced. The change is in `apps/backend/src/timeline.ts`.
- **Existing duplicates:** a migration deletes all but the latest write of each chat, so the rows in your screenshot collapse too. It runs when the back end restarts on this commit, so I haven't seen it work on your live timeline yet.
- **Tests:** I added a test for this to `apps/backend/test/timeline.test.ts`. The timeline tests and the back-end type check pass.
- **Knowledge graph:** [Timeline screen](Frontend/Screen/timeline) now says a chat has one event, its latest write. To stay under the 700-character limit with the new line, I shortened some of the card's other lines without changing what they say.

The interview automation records its messages as the same kind of event, so its rows are combined the same way.
